title: New Job, New Rules: Lin Tao's First Week
instructions: 这是为A2学习者设计的原创模拟听力与语法练习（非官方雅思材料）。先听/读对话，注意新员工Lin Tao学习公司规定的场景。听力部分有8道题：单选题、填空题和判断题（True/False/Not Given）。所有题目和选项均为英文，解释为中文。语法部分先讲解have to / must / can的用法及一般现在时与过去时的对比，然后完成8道新句子练习。最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。
transcript:
Mia: Good morning, Lin Tao. Welcome to your first week. I'm Mia, your team leader.
Lin Tao: Good morning, Mia. Thank you. I'm a little nervous.
Mia: That's normal. Let's talk about the rules. First, you have to arrive at 9 a.m. every day.
Lin Tao: OK. Do I have to wear a uniform?
Mia: No, you don't. But you must wear your name badge. You can wear jeans on Friday.
Lin Tao: Great. What about lunch?
Mia: You can take one hour for lunch. But you must tell me if you leave the office.
Lin Tao: I see. And the phone?
Mia: You can use your phone for calls, but you must not use it in meetings.
Lin Tao: Understood. What did you do last week?
Mia: I visited a client on Monday. I wrote three reports on Tuesday. Yesterday I had a long meeting.
Lin Tao: Did you have to work late?
Mia: Yes, I did. I worked until 8 p.m. But today I can leave at 5.
Lin Tao: Good. One more question. Can I ask you for help?
Mia: Of course. You can ask me any time. But you have to send an email first.
Lin Tao: OK. I sent one this morning.
Mia: Perfect. You're doing well.

questions.prompt: What time must Lin Tao arrive at work?
questions.explanation: Mia说“you have to arrive at 9 a.m. every day”，所以必须9点到。
questions.evidence: you have to arrive at 9 a.m. every day.

questions.prompt: Does Lin Tao have to wear a uniform?
questions.explanation: Mia回答“No, you don't.”，说明不需要穿制服。

questions.prompt: Lin Tao must wear his ______ badge.
questions.explanation: Mia说“you must wear your name badge”，所以填name。
questions.evidence: you must wear your name badge.

questions.prompt: What can Lin Tao wear on Friday?
questions.explanation: Mia说“You can wear jeans on Friday.”，所以周五可以穿牛仔裤。
questions.evidence: You can wear jeans on Friday.

questions.prompt: How long can Lin Tao take for lunch?
questions.explanation: Mia说“You can take one hour for lunch.”，所以午餐时间是一小时。
questions.evidence: You can take one hour for lunch.

questions.prompt: What must Lin Tao NOT do in meetings?
questions.explanation: Mia说“you must not use it in meetings”，it指手机，所以开会时不能用手机。
questions.evidence: you must not use it in meetings.

questions.prompt: What did Mia do on Monday?
questions.explanation: Mia说“I visited a client on Monday.”，所以周一她拜访了客户。
questions.evidence: I visited a client on Monday.

questions.prompt: Lin Tao must send an email before he asks Mia for help.
questions.explanation: Mia说“you have to send an email first”，所以林涛必须先发邮件再求助。
questions.evidence: But you have to send an email first.

grammar.title: have to / must / can 与一般现在时和过去时对比
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，have to 和 must 都表示“必须”，但 have to 更强调客观规定（如公司规定），must 更强调说话人的强烈要求。can 表示“可以、能够”。一般现在时表示经常性动作或规定，如 you have to arrive at 9 a.m.；一般过去时表示过去发生的动作，如 I visited a client on Monday。注意：have to 的第三人称单数是 has to；must 没有时态变化；can 的过去式是 could。
grammar.example: you have to arrive at 9 a.m. every day.

questions.prompt: Every day, Sarah ______ wear a uniform at work.
questions.explanation: 主语Sarah是第三人称单数，所以用has to。
questions.evidence: you have to arrive at 9 a.m. every day.

questions.prompt: Yesterday, Tom ______ a report for his manager.
questions.explanation: Yesterday表示过去，所以用过去式wrote。
questions.evidence: I wrote three reports on Tuesday.

questions.prompt: You ______ use your phone in the meeting room. It is not allowed.
questions.explanation: 表示禁止，用must not；don't have to表示不必。
questions.evidence: you must not use it in meetings.

questions.prompt: ______ you have to work late last Friday?
questions.explanation: last Friday是过去时间，所以用Did构成一般过去时疑问句。
questions.evidence: Did you have to work late?

questions.prompt: Lisa ______ speak three languages. She is very good.
questions.evidence: You can ask me any time.

questions.prompt: We ______ arrive at 8 a.m. tomorrow. It is a rule.
questions.explanation: 主语We是复数，表示规定，用have to。
questions.evidence: you have to arrive at 9 a.m. every day.

questions.prompt: Last week, Anna ______ to the office every day.
questions.evidence: I visited a client on Monday.

questions.prompt: You ______ take a one-hour lunch break. It is allowed.
questions.evidence: You can take one hour for lunch.

transfer.writing: Write a short email (about 50 words) to a new colleague. Tell them three rules at your workplace. Use have to, must, and can. Also say what you did last week.
